findings.description: The Microlensed-PE row (line 55, 'Fast path (Builds 3/3b)' sentence) still describes the removed machinery: `_DEFAULT_KERNEL_NODES = 100`, the FULL-CLUSTER node-grid union, 'smooth channel kernels K_a(w) engine-evaluated ... then cubic-splined to bin sub-samples', and the F008 full-cluster switch rule. The code is now SACR-C: a single beat-free transition envelope E(w) evaluated on a leave-one-out-adaptive coarse grid (_LOO_SEED_NODES=8, _LOO_STOP=4e-3, _LOO_MAX_NODES=48), closed-form kernel reconstruction (reconstruct_from_envelope), and a criticality-separation switch |tau_a - tau_c| that supersedes F008. The diff left SPEC.md unmodified though the plan listed it as expected-to-change, breaking the spec->artifact invariant.
